Test Case: Verify that the 'Supreme Ventures Gaming' link is visible in the header.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the web browser and navigate to the application's home page.
2. Observe the header menu at the top of the screen.
Expected Outcome: The text 'Supreme Ventures Gaming' should be clearly visible in the header navigation menu.

Test Case: Verify that clicking 'Supreme Ventures Gaming' displays the four main category cards.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click on the 'Supreme Ventures Gaming' link in the header.
2. Observe the main content area of the page.
Expected Outcome: User should redirect to the 'Supreme Ventures Gaming' page. Four distinct cards should be displayed with the following names: 'SV Games' , 'JUSTBET', 'MBet' , and 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' .

Test Case: Verify that the user can navigate to the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' screen.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. On the main landing page, locate the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' card.
2. Click on the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' button.
Expected Outcome: The user should  redirected to the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' page. The screen should display a list of available  games.

Test Case: Verify the visual elements of the Acropolis Gaming page.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' page.
2. Observe the top section of the page.
Expected Outcome: The page should display the title 'ACROPOLIS GAMING - EXPERIENCE THE PEAK OF GAMING EXCELLENCE' and a search bar with the placeholder text 'Search your favourite game...'.

Test Case: Verify that additional games are loaded when the user scrolls down the game list.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. On the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' page, scroll down the list of games until you reach the bottom of the visible list.
2. Continue scrolling and observe whether new game cards are added to the list.
Expected Outcome: New games should be loaded and appended to the existing game list as the user scrolls down (infinite scroll / lazy loading). Existing games should remain visible and the list should grow.

Test Case: Verify that the user can search for a specific game (e.g., '5 Lions').
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click into the search bar on the Acropolis Gaming page.
2. Type '5 Lions' into the search field.
3. Click the 'SEARCH' button.
Expected Outcome: The game list should update to show only the games matching the search term (e.g., '5 Lions', '5 Lions Gold', '5 Lions Megaways').

Test Case: Verify that game cards display 'Play Now' and 'Try Demo' options.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the '5 Lions' game card in the list.
2. Hover the mouse cursor over the game card (or observe the card details).
Expected Outcome: The card should display two distinct options: 'Play Now' and 'Try Demo'.

Test Case: Verify that 'Try Demo' launches the game in demo mode.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the '5 Lions' game card.
2. Click on the 'Try Demo' button.
Expected Outcome: The '5 Lions' game should load successfully. The user should be able to play for fun without any real money being deducted.

Test Case: Verify that clicking 'Play Now' without logging in redirects to the login page.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click on the 'Play Now' button.
2. Ensure the user is currently logged out.
Expected Outcome: The user is redirected to the 'Sign In' page containing fields for 'Country code', 'Mobile Number', and 'Account PIN'.

Test Case: Verify that the user can log in successfully to proceed to the game.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. On the 'Sign In' page, select the correct 'Country code'.
2. Enter a valid 'Mobile Number'.
3. Enter the valid 'Account PIN'.
4. Click the 'Sign Up' (or Sign In) button.
Expected Outcome: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected back to the 'ACROPOLIS GAMING' page or directly into the '5 Lions' game.

Test Case: Verify that clicking 'Play Now' after login transitions the user to the game loading screen.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the '5 Lions' game card in the lobby.
2. Click the 'Play Now' button.
3. Complete the login process if prompted by the system.
Expected Outcome: The user is successfully redirected from the lobby to a dedicated loading screen for the '5 Lions' game.

Test Case: Verify that the game loading screen displays the correct branding and progress bar.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Observe the screen while the '5 Lions' game is in the process of loading.
Expected Outcome: The dark loading screen should clearly display the 'Pragmatic Play' logo in the center, with an orange loading progress bar filling up underneath it.

Test Case: Verify that the '5 Lions' main game screen loads successfully.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Wait for the orange loading progress bar to complete.
2. Observe the main screen that appears next.
Expected Outcome: The main game interface should appear, showing the '5 Lions' title, the slot reels populated with symbols, and the blue patterned background.

Test Case: Verify that the top header displays the lobby navigation and play status.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. On the main game screen, look at the dark navigation bar at the very top.
Expected Outcome: The top header should display a 'BACK TO LOBBY' button with an arrow on the left, and the text 'REAL PLAY' next to a full-screen expand icon on the right.

Test Case: Verify that the bottom information bar displays the current credit and bet amounts.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Look at the bottom left section of the main game screen, just below the slot reels.
Expected Outcome: The screen should accurately display the user's available balance next to the word 'CREDIT', and the current active wager amount next to the word 'BET'.

Test Case: Verify that the 'WIN' amount section is clearly visible.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Look at the bottom center of the main game screen, directly below the slot reels.
Expected Outcome: A 'WIN' section should be visible, displaying the amount won in large text, with the word 'PAYS' and its corresponding amount displayed just beneath it.

Test Case: Verify that the system settings and volume icons are visible.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Look at the far bottom left corner of the game screen, below the credit information.
Expected Outcome: A hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) for system settings and a speaker icon for volume control should be clearly visible to the user.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'i' icon opens the Game Rules screen.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the 'i' (Information) icon near the bottom left of the screen.
2. Click the 'i' icon.
Expected Outcome: A 'GAME RULES' window should pop up and overlay the reels, showing the first page of instructions and symbol values.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the '+' or '-' button opens the Bet Settings menu.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the large circular spin button at the bottom right of the screen.
2. Click either the '+' (plus) or '-' (minus) button located on either side of the spin button.
Expected Outcome: A 'BET MULTIPLIER' menu box should open, displaying controls to adjust the bet, coin value, and total bet.

Test Case: Verify that the user can adjust the 'Bet' level in the Bet Settings menu.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Bet Settings menu.
2. In the 'BET' row, click the '-' button to decrease or the '+' button to increase the value.
Expected Outcome: The numeric value displayed inside the 'BET' box should increase or decrease accordingly based on the button clicked.

Test Case: Verify that the user can adjust the 'Coin Value' in the Bet Settings menu.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Bet Settings menu.
2. In the 'COIN VALUE' row, click the '-' button to decrease or the '+' button to increase the value.
Expected Outcome: The numeric value displayed inside the 'COIN VALUE' box should increase or decrease accordingly based on the button clicked.

Test Case: Verify that the 'Total Bet' updates automatically when bet settings are changed.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Bet Settings menu.
2. Change either the 'BET' amount or the 'COIN VALUE' amount.
3. Observe the numeric value in the 'TOTAL BET' row.
Expected Outcome: The 'TOTAL BET' box should automatically recalculate and display the new total amount based on the adjusted settings above it.

Test Case: Verify that the 'BET MAX' button is visible in the Bet Settings menu.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Bet Settings menu.
2. Locate the 'BET MAX' button at the bottom of the menu box.
Expected Outcome: A green 'BET MAX' button should be clearly visible, providing an option to instantly set the wager to the highest allowed value.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'AUTOPLAY' text opens the Autoplay Settings menu.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Locate the 'AUTOPLAY' text positioned just below the main circular spin button.
2. Click on the 'AUTOPLAY' text.
Expected Outcome: An 'AUTOPLAY SETTINGS' menu box should open over the reels, displaying options for automatic spinning.

Test Case: Verify that the Autoplay Settings menu contains selectable speed and screen options.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Autoplay Settings menu.
2. Observe the checkbox options available in the top half of the menu.
Expected Outcome: The menu should display three clearly labeled, selectable checkboxes: 'TURBO SPIN', 'QUICK SPIN', and 'SKIP SCREENS'.

Test Case: Verify that the user can select the number of autospins using the slider.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Autoplay Settings menu.
2. Locate the slider bar under the 'NUMBER OF AUTOSPINS' heading.
3. Drag the green slider handle left or right.
Expected Outcome: The numeric value displayed next to the slider should update to reflect the chosen number of spins (e.g., 10, 20, 30, up to 100).

Test Case: Verify that the 'START AUTOPLAY' button reflects the selected number of spins.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Autoplay Settings menu.
2. Adjust the number of autospins using the slider.
3. Look at the large green button at the bottom of the menu box.
Expected Outcome: The text on the green button should read 'START AUTOPLAY' followed by the exact number selected on the slider displayed in parentheses (e.g., 'START AUTOPLAY (100)').

Test Case: Verify that Page 1 of the Game Rules displays the correct payout symbols.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click the 'i' icon to open the Game Rules.
2. Ensure the screen displays 'Page 1/8' in the bottom right corner.
3. Observe the top section of the rules page.
Expected Outcome: The page should display the payout values and artwork for various game symbols, including the Dragon, Phoenix, Frog, Fish, Turtle, A, K, Q, J, 10, and 9.

Test Case: Verify that Page 1 of the Game Rules displays the visual diagrams for winning ways.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Game Rules to Page 1/8.
2. Look at the lower half of the rules page.
Expected Outcome: Visual grid diagrams demonstrating '243 ways to win' and '576 ways to win' should be visible, using green checkmarks to show valid combinations and red 'X's for invalid ones.

Test Case: Verify that the user can navigate to the next page of the Game Rules.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Game Rules to Page 1/8.
2. Locate the bright green navigation arrows at the bottom left of the rules box.
3. Click the right-pointing arrow.
Expected Outcome: The screen should transition to display 'Page 2/8' of the Game Rules in the bottom right corner.

Test Case: Verify that Page 2 of the Game Rules explains the WILD symbol.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to Page 2/8 of the Game Rules.
2. Observe the top section of the page.
Expected Outcome: The page should display the golden lion face symbol and explain that it is WILD, appears only on reels 2, 3, and 4, and offers random multiplier values.

Test Case: Verify that Page 2 of the Game Rules explains the SCATTER symbol.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to Page 2/8 of the Game Rules.
2. Observe the bottom section of the page.
Expected Outcome: The page should display the Yin Yang symbol, identify it as the SCATTER, and explain how landing 3, 4, or 5 symbols triggers the FREE SPINS FEATURE.

Test Case: Verify that the user can navigate through and view all remaining Game Rules pages.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the Game Rules screen by clicking the 'i' icon.
2. Click the right-pointing navigation arrow to move past page 2.
3. Continue clicking the right arrow to view pages 3 through 8.
Expected Outcome: The user is successfully able to navigate through all 8 pages, and each subsequent page displays the corresponding game rules, features, and technical requirements clearly.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the hamburger menu icon opens a left sidebar.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. On the main game screen, locate the hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) at the bottom left.
2. Click the hamburger menu icon.
Expected Outcome: A sidebar menu opens on the left side of the screen displaying three icons with text: 'LOBBY', 'REPLAY', and 'SETTINGS'.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'SETTINGS' icon opens the 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the left sidebar menu.
2. Click the 'SETTINGS' (gear) icon.
Expected Outcome: A 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal window pops up and overlays the main game screen.

Test Case: Verify that the 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal displays a 'GAME HISTORY' link and 'TOTAL BET' adjustment controls.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal.
2. Observe the left side of the modal box.
Expected Outcome: The modal should display a clickable 'GAME HISTORY' link with an external window icon, and a 'TOTAL BET' section with '-' and '+' buttons to adjust the bet amount.

Test Case: Verify that the 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal contains toggle switches for system preferences.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the 'SYSTEM SETTINGS' modal.
2. Observe the right side of the modal box.
Expected Outcome: The modal should display toggle switches for 'BATTERY SAVER', 'AMBIENT MUSIC', 'SOUND FX', 'INTRO SCREEN', and 'ENABLE ALERTS', allowing the user to turn these features on or off.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'REPLAY' icon opens the 'Pragmatic Replay' modal.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the left sidebar menu.
2. Click the 'REPLAY' (play button with an arrow) icon.
Expected Outcome: A 'Pragmatic Replay' modal window pops up on the screen, containing two tabs at the top: 'LATEST WINS' and 'MY TOP WINS'.

Test Case: Verify that the 'LATEST WINS' tab displays a table of recent wins.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the 'Pragmatic Replay' modal.
2. Click on the 'LATEST WINS' tab.
Expected Outcome: A table is displayed showing the user's recent wins with column headers for 'Time', 'Bet ID', 'WinX', 'Bet', 'Win', 'Link', and 'Watch'.

Test Case: Verify that the 'MY TOP WINS' tab displays a table of the user's highest wins.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the 'Pragmatic Replay' modal.
2. Click on the 'MY TOP WINS' tab.
Expected Outcome: A table is displayed showing the user's highest wins, using the same column format (Time, Bet ID, WinX, Bet, Win, Link, Watch) to review top performance.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'LOBBY' icon redirects the user to the Pragmatic Play games lobby screen.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Open the left sidebar menu.
2. Click the 'LOBBY' (four squares) icon.
Expected Outcome: The current game closes, and the user is successfully redirected to the main Pragmatic Play lobby screen.

Test Case: Verify that the Pragmatic Play lobby screen displays the correct navigation menu and game grid.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the Pragmatic Play lobby screen.
2. Observe the left sidebar and the main content area on the right.
Expected Outcome: The left sidebar should display the Pragmatic Play logo and a menu containing options for 'For You', 'Search', 'New', 'Slots', and 'More' (which contains exit options). The right side should display a grid of game cards under 'Recommended Games'.

Test Case: Verify that the balance amount displayed in the Pragmatic Play lobby matches the main website wallet balance.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the Pragmatic Play lobby screen.
2. Check the numeric balance amount shown at the bottom of the left navigation menu.
3. Look at the top right header of the main website to view the primary wallet balance.
4. Compare the two amounts.
Expected Outcome: The balance amount displayed at the bottom left of the lobby must exactly match the total wallet balance shown in the top right header.

Test Case: Verify that for playing the game, the user can spin the reels manually by clicking the main circular spin button.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Ensure a valid bet amount is set.
2. Locate the large circular spin button with two arrows at the bottom right of the screen.
3. Click the spin button once.
Expected Outcome: The reels spin and then stop to reveal the outcome, confirming the user can play the game manually.

Test Case: Verify that for playing the game, the user can spin the reels automatically using the configured Autoplay feature.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click the 'AUTOPLAY' text to open the settings.
2. Select a number of autospins using the slider.
3. Click the green 'START AUTOPLAY' button.
4. Do not click anything else and observe the game.
Expected Outcome: The reels spin automatically for the specified number of rounds without requiring the user to click the manual spin button.

Test Case: Verify that for playing the game, the user can initiate a Turbo Spin by holding down the Spacebar on their keyboard.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Observe the text instruction 'HOLD SPACE FOR TURBO SPIN' at the bottom center of the game screen.
2. Press and hold the Spacebar on your physical keyboard.
Expected Outcome: The reels spin at a much faster (turbo) speed to play the game quickly, and continue to do so as long as the spacebar is held down.

Test Case: Verify that placing a bet instantly deducts the wager amount simultaneously from the in-game 'CREDIT' and the main top-right header wallet.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Note the current balance shown in the in-game 'CREDIT' area and the top-right header wallet.
2. Note the current 'BET' amount.
3. Click the spin button to place the bet.
4. Immediately check both balance areas.
Expected Outcome: The exact bet amount is deducted from the in-game 'CREDIT' and the top-right header wallet in perfect synchronization, ensuring both amounts match.

Test Case: Verify that winning a spin instantly adds the won amount simultaneously to the in-game 'CREDIT' and the main top-right header wallet.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Play the game until a winning combination lands.
2. Note the amount shown in the 'WIN' section.
3. Check the updated balances in the in-game 'CREDIT' area and the top-right header wallet.
Expected Outcome: The exact won amount is added to both the in-game 'CREDIT' and the main top-right header wallet simultaneously, ensuring perfect synchronization across the UI.

Test Case: Verify that an 'Info' warning modal appears with a countdown timer after a period of user inactivity.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Leave the game open.
2. Do not interact with the screen, keyboard, or mouse for a set period of time (e.g., a few minutes).
3. Observe the center of the screen.
Expected Outcome: A white 'Info' modal pops up stating 'You've been inactive for a while' and displays a live countdown timer showing minutes and seconds remaining.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'Keep Playing' button on the inactivity modal resumes the active session.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Wait for the white 'Info' inactivity modal to appear on the screen.
2. Click the green 'Keep Playing' button inside the modal.
Expected Outcome: The inactivity modal closes, the timer stops, and the user can continue playing the game normally without losing their session.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'Log Out' button on the inactivity modal ends the session immediately.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Wait for the white 'Info' inactivity modal to appear on the screen.
2. Click the red 'Log Out' button inside the modal.
Expected Outcome: The game session ends immediately, and the user is logged out of their current session.

Test Case: Verify that allowing the inactivity countdown timer to reach zero triggers the 'Please Log In' session expiration modal.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Wait for the white 'Info' inactivity modal to appear on the screen.
2. Do not click any buttons.
3. Let the countdown timer run out to 0:00.
Expected Outcome: The screen darkens, and a dark 'Please Log In' modal appears stating 'Your session has expired or you need to log in to continue playing.'

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'OKAY' button on the 'Please Log In' modal redirects the user to the application's login page.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Wait for the dark 'Please Log In' session expiration modal to appear.
2. Click the golden 'OKAY' button inside the modal.
Expected Outcome: The user is redirected entirely out of the gaming interface and lands on the main application login page.

Test Case: Verify that the user can see the 'iCasino' option under the 'Bet History' menu in the header.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Look at the top navigation header.
2. Click or hover over the 'Bet History' dropdown menu.
Expected Outcome: The dropdown menu opens and the 'iCasino' bet history option is clearly visible to the user.

Test Case: Verify that the iCasino Bet History page contains date and status filters with a search button.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click on 'iCasino' under the 'Bet History' menu to open the page.
2. Observe the top section of the 'iCasino Bet History' page.
Expected Outcome: The page displays filter fields for 'Date From', 'Date To', and a 'Status' dropdown, along with a green 'Search' button.

Test Case: Verify that the iCasino Bet History cards display all correct details for both played and won bets.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the 'iCasino Bet History' page.
2. Look at the list of bet cards displayed below the filters.
Expected Outcome: Each card displays the 'Ref Number', 'Game' (e.g., 5 Lions), 'Round ID', 'Date', and 'Bet Amount'. Winning cards also display a 'Winning Amount' and a green 'WON' trophy badge, while non-winning cards show a blue 'PLAYED' slot machine badge.

Test Case: Verify that the 'Transaction' menu is present in the top header.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Look at the main top navigation header from any screen in the application.
Expected Outcome: The 'Transaction' menu item is clearly visible in the header next to 'Bet History'.

Test Case: Verify that clicking the 'Transaction' menu redirects the user to the Transaction Summary page.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Click on the 'Transaction' menu item in the top header.
Expected Outcome: The user is successfully redirected to the 'Transaction Summary' page.

Test Case: Verify that the user can filter the Transaction Summary by selecting 'iCasino' in the Platform Type.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the 'Transaction Summary' page.
2. Observe the filter options at the top (Date From, Date To, Platform Type, Transaction Type, Status).
3. Click the 'Platform Type' dropdown and select 'iCasino'.
4. Click the green 'Search' button.
Expected Outcome: The system applies the filters and the transaction list updates to show only the records associated with the 'iCasino' platform.

Test Case: Verify that the Transaction Summary cards display all correct transaction data fields.
Test Procedures/Steps: 1. Navigate to the 'Transaction Summary' page.
2. Look at the individual transaction cards listed below the search filters.
Expected Outcome: Each card clearly displays the transaction 'ID', 'Time', 'Platform Type', 'Status' (e.g., COMPLETED), 'Amount', 'Date', and 'Transaction Type' (e.g., Debit or Winnings), along with a green checkmark icon on the right.
